evidence_class: posthoc frozen-output diagnostic on already-open 79-species exploratory layer
question: Was the exploratory 79-species gain specific to the actual island-network adjacency, or would degree- and edge-length-matched surrogate topologies yield the same gain?

estimands.all_cells: equal-weight across 168 blocks of logloss(actual_C,y) minus mean_j logloss(rewired_C_j,y)
estimands.presence_cells: equal-weight across presence-bearing blocks of the same actual-minus-rewired contrast among y=1 cells
estimands.absence_cells: equal-weight across blocks of the same actual-minus-rewired contrast among y=0 cells
estimands.actual_vs_each_null: report block-weighted C_rewired_j-minus-R3 for all 20 nulls and count nulls worse than actual C

interpretation.negative: actual topology is descriptively better than the matched null ensemble
interpretation.near_zero: the exploratory gain is not topology-specific and is better described as network-transformed source context
interpretation.positive: matched surrogate topology outperforms the actual adjacency
